0022600112.text: The 2-0 Lakers, first in the Pacific and the West, visit a Utah Jazz team that is 1-1, fifth in the Northwest and one game back, and ninth in the West. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), while Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The Lakers swept the 4-0 season series in 2025-26, most recently winning 131-107 in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026, and the two teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season.
